articles: Rails is a web application framework running on the Ruby programming language. It makes building web apps faster and easier with conventions over configuration.
MVC stands for Model-View-Controller. Models handle data and business logic, Views display information to users, and Controllers coordinate between them.
Ruby2JS transpiles Ruby to JavaScript, enabling Rails applications to run in browsers, on Node.js, and at the edge. Same code, different runtimes.

# frozen_string_literal: true
module CalibrationBoundaries
  CATEGORIES = { total: 0, routing: 1, controller: 2, ar: 4, rendering: 8,
    events: 16, security: 32, query: 64, instantiate: 128, attributes: 256,
    escaping: 512, buffers: 1024 }.freeze
  @targets = {}

  def self.add(holder, names, *categories)
    mask = categories.sum { CATEGORIES.fetch(_1) }
    names.each do |name|
      raise "missing #{holder}##{name}" unless holder.method_defined?(name) || holder.private_method_defined?(name)
      key = [holder, name]
      @targets[key] = @targets.fetch(key, 0) | mask
    end
  end

  def self.install(emit)
    if emit
      add(ActionDispatch::Router.singleton_class, [:match], :routing)
      add(ArticlesController, [:process_action], :controller)
      add(Views::Articles.singleton_class, [:index, :show], :rendering)
      add(Views::Layouts.singleton_class, [:application], :rendering)
      [Article, Comment].each do |model|
        add(model.singleton_class, [:from_stmt, :from_row], :ar, :instantiate)
        add(model, [:id, :title, :body, :article_id, :commenter].select { model.method_defined?(_1) }, :ar, :attributes)
      end
      add(Article.singleton_class, [:find], :ar)
      add(Article, [:comments, :_preload_comments], :ar)
      add(Db.singleton_class, [:prepare, :step?, :finalize, :column_int, :column_text, :column_text_opt], :ar, :query)
      add(ActionController::Base, [:verify_authenticity_token], :security)
      add(ActionController::AuthenticityToken.singleton_class, [:masked], :security)
      add(ActionDispatch::Session.singleton_class, [:from_signed_cookie, :signed_cookie], :security)
      add(ActionDispatch::Session, [:to_cookie], :security)
      add(ActionView::ViewHelpers.singleton_class, [:html_escape], :escaping)
      add(ViewBufferCap.singleton_class, [:alloc, :store], :buffers)
      add(ActiveSupport::Notifications.singleton_class, [:instrument], :events)
    else
      add(ActionDispatch::Journey::Router, [:serve], :routing)
      add(ActionController::Metal, [:dispatch], :controller)
      add(ActionView::Template, [:render], :rendering)
      add(ActionView::Renderer, [:render_to_object], :rendering)
      add(ActionView::CollectionRenderer, [:render_collection_with_partial, :render_collection_derive_partial], :rendering)
      add(ActiveRecord::Relation, [:exec_queries, :build_arel], :ar)
      add(ActiveRecord::Relation, [:includes!, :order!], :ar)
      add(Article.singleton_class, [:includes, :find], :ar)
      add(ActiveRecord::Associations::Preloader, [:call], :ar)
      add(ActiveRecord::Associations::CollectionAssociation, [:size, :load_target], :ar)
      add(ActiveRecord::AttributeMethods::Read, [:read_attribute, :_read_attribute], :ar, :attributes)
      add(ActiveRecord::ConnectionAdapters::SQLite3Adapter, [:internal_exec_query], :ar, :query)
      add(Article.singleton_class, [:instantiate, :instantiate_instance_of], :ar, :instantiate)
      add(Comment.singleton_class, [:instantiate, :instantiate_instance_of], :ar, :instantiate)
      add(ActionDispatch::Session::CookieStore, [:load_session, :commit_session], :security)
      add(ActionDispatch::Cookies::CookieJar, [:write], :security)
      add(ActionController::RequestForgeryProtection, [:form_authenticity_token, :verify_authenticity_token, :commit_csrf_token], :security)
      add(ERB::Util.singleton_class, [:html_escape, :unwrapped_html_escape], :escaping)
      add(ActionView::OutputBuffer, [:<<, :safe_concat, :safe_append=, :safe_expr_append=, :append=], :buffers)
      add(ActiveSupport::Notifications::Instrumenter, [:build_handle], :events)
      add(ActiveSupport::Notifications::Fanout::Handle, [:start, :finish], :events)
    end
    add(CGI.singleton_class, [:escapeHTML], :escaping)
    @targets.each do |(holder, name), mask|
      visibility = holder.private_method_defined?(name) ? :private : holder.protected_method_defined?(name) ? :protected : :public
      wrapper = Module.new
      wrapper.module_eval(<<~RUBY, __FILE__, __LINE__ + 1)
        def #{name}(...)
          entered = LowrailCallgrindBench.enter(#{mask})
          begin
            super
          ensure
            LowrailCallgrindBench.leave(entered)
          end
        end
        #{visibility} :#{name}
      RUBY
      holder.prepend(wrapper)
    end
  end
end

  app, = Rack::Builder.parse_file("config.ru")

  app = Rails.application

  events << { name: name, sql: payload[:sql], cached: payload[:cached], keys: payload.keys.map(&:to_s).sort }
})

  [path, { status: response.status, events: Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(events)) }]
end

require "/tmp/calibration_gate"
def arithmetic(n)
  sum = 0
  n.times { |i| sum += i }
  raise "wrong sum" unless sum == n * (n - 1) / 2
end
3.times do |window|
  LowrailCallgrindBench.select_category(1)
  LowrailCallgrindBench.start(false)
  arithmetic(100_000) if window == 1
  entered = LowrailCallgrindBench.enter(1)
  arithmetic(10_000)
  if window == 2
    nested = LowrailCallgrindBench.enter(1)
    LowrailCallgrindBench.leave(nested)
  end
  LowrailCallgrindBench.leave(entered)
  arithmetic(100_000) if window == 1
  LowrailCallgrindBench.finish
end
puts "arithmetic and nested boundaries pass"

require "/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/request_pairs"
require "shellwords"
cc = RbConfig::CONFIG.fetch("LDSHARED").shellsplit
raise "gate compilation failed" unless system(*cc, "-fPIC", "-O2",
  "-I#{RbConfig::CONFIG.fetch('rubyhdrdir')}", "-I#{RbConfig::CONFIG.fetch('rubyarchhdrdir')}",
  "/tmp/calibration_gate.c", "-o", "/tmp/calibration_gate.so")
out = ARGV.fetch(0)
raise "new profile directory" if File.exist?(out)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
slots = %w[1000000 250000 100000 20000 10000]
floors = slots.each_with_index.to_h { |count, pool| ["RUBY_GC_HEAP_#{pool}_INIT_SLOTS", count] }
jobs = %w[rails emit].product(%w[index show])
threads = jobs.map do |arm, route|
  Thread.new do
    app = arm == "rails" ? "/home/user/workspace/repo/.corpus/real-blog-r4" : "/tmp/roundhouse-blog-emit"
    label = "#{arm}-#{route}"
    base = File.join(out, label)
    env = floors.merge("RAILS_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "LOWRAIL" => "0",
      "RAILS_LOG_LEVEL" => "error", "RUBYOPT" => nil, "CALIBRATION_EMIT" => arm == "emit" ? "1" : "0")
    ok = system(env, "valgrind", "--verbose", "--tool=callgrind", "--instr-atstart=no", "--smc-check=all-non-file",
      "--callgrind-out-file=#{base}.callgrind", "--log-file=#{base}.valgrind.log", RbConfig.ruby, "--disable-yjit",
      "/tmp/calibration_profile.rb", route == "index" ? "/articles" : "/articles/1", chdir: app,
      out: base + ".json", err: base + ".log")
    RequestPairs.check_valgrind_log!(out, label)
    raise "profile failed: #{label}" unless ok
    result = JSON.parse(File.read(base + ".json"))
    result.fetch("windows").each_with_index do |window, i|
      window["instructions"] = RequestPairs.instruction_total("#{base}.callgrind.#{i + 1}")
    end
    costs = result.fetch("windows").group_by { _1.fetch("unit") }.transform_values do |windows|
      %w[total no_gc].to_h do |mode|
        zero, full = windows.select { _1.fetch("mode") == mode }.sort_by { _1.fetch("requests") }
        [mode, (full.fetch("instructions") - zero.fetch("instructions")) / 50.0]
      end
    end
    File.write(base + "-results.json", JSON.pretty_generate(windows: result.fetch("windows"), costs: costs))
    puts "PROFILE #{label}: #{costs}"
  rescue StandardError => error
    error
  end
end
threads.map(&:value).each { raise _1 if _1.is_a?(Exception) }

  "RUBYOPT" => nil, "RAILS_LOG_LEVEL" => "error", "BENCH_WARMUP" => "50" }
environments = { "off_a" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => rails), "off_b" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => rails),
  "emit_a" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => emit, "CALIBRATION_EMIT" => "1"),
  "emit_b" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => emit, "CALIBRATION_EMIT" => "1") }
%w[0 1].each do |jit|
  ENV["BENCH_JIT"] = jit
  { "index" => "/articles", "show" => "/articles/1" }.each do |name, path|
    dir = File.join(root, "#{jit == '1' ? 'yjit' : 'interpreter'}-#{name}")
    raise "existing cohort" if File.exist?(dir)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
    metadata = { seed: 41231, rounds: 6, workers: {} }
    accepted = RequestPairs.heap_instructions(environments, rails, dir, "GET:#{path}", metadata,
      worker: "/tmp/calibration_worker.rb")
    raw = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(dir, "samples.json")))
    emit_control = RequestPairs.summarize(raw.fetch("samples").map do |row|
      { "off_a" => row.fetch("emit_a"), "off_b" => row.fetch("emit_b") }
    end, seed: 41231, tolerance: 0.5, metrics: %w[instructions_total instructions_no_gc allocations],
      controls: %w[instructions_total instructions_no_gc])
    File.write(File.join(dir, "emit-control.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(emit_control))
    puts "COHORT #{dir} accepted=#{accepted && emit_control.fetch(:aa).fetch(:pass)}"
    $stdout.flush
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
ROOT = "/home/user/workspace/repo"
unless ENV["CALIBRATION_EMIT"] == "1"
  load File.join(ROOT, "bench/heap_requests.rb")
  exit
end
require "bundler/setup"
require "rack/mock"
require "rack/builder"
require "json"
app, = Rack::Builder.parse_file(File.join(Dir.pwd, "config.ru"))
require File.join(ROOT, "bench/heap_windows")
require ENV.fetch("BENCH_CALLGRIND_EXTENSION")
verb, path = ARGV.fetch(0).split(":", 2)
session = Rack::MockRequest.new(app)
headers = { "HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on" }
n = Integer(ENV.fetch("BENCH_REQUESTS", "50"))
def counted_requests(n, session, verb, path, headers)
  n.times do
    response = session.request(verb, path, headers)
    raise "#{verb} #{path} -> #{response.status}" unless (200..299).cover?(response.status)
  end
end
windows = HeapWindows.windows(n)
counted_requests(Integer(ENV.fetch("BENCH_WARMUP", "50")), session, verb, path, headers)
if RubyVM::YJIT.enabled?
  require File.join(ROOT, "bench/jit_stability")
  jit_warmup = JitStability.warm { |count| counted_requests(count, session, verb, path, headers) }
  observe = JitStability.method(:snapshot)
end
anchors = HeapWindows.run(windows, observe: observe,
  settle: -> { counted_requests(1, session, verb, path, headers) }) do |count|
  counted_requests(count, session, verb, path, headers)
end
puts "LOWRAIL_BENCH #{JSON.generate(ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION, yjit: !!RubyVM::YJIT.enabled?, windows: windows,
  heap_anchors: anchors, ar_installed: 0, jit_warmup: jit_warmup, request_settle: true)}"
